# Lumaform Aqueous vendor note

The preview bundle contains `createOrb` and the named `aqueous` engine from `@lumaform/orb@0.3.1`, bundled with `three@0.160.0`. Both packages are MIT licensed; their upstream license texts are kept here as `LICENSE` and `THREE-LICENSE.txt`.

Upstream sources: [Lumaform Orb](https://github.com/abektes/lumaform-orb) and [Three.js](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js). The build entry retained in this repository is `tools/vendor-lumaform-entry.js`; the generated module is `dist/lumaform-aqueous.js`. No paid engine or Pro asset is included.
